description: The app's collections of the page's heap (PageMemory, ARCHITECTURE.md §7.7) as an A/B: none, every 30 s, every 10 s, none again, at Lumbridge with the bots in, then every 30 s with the chat model loaded and replying every 10 s. Activity Monitor samples (3 s) twice a window; the phone's Web Inspector (Memory categories: 'javascript' is the page's heap; e.g. through pymobiledevice3) can record each window alongside. Run with --bots 1000. Measured 2026-10-27 (iPhone 13 mini): WebContent's median 776 / 742 / 739 / 804 MB, the page's heap 274 / 222 / 206 / 260.
